subject: Working capital smoothing & interim retainage plan for pilot
messages:
From: Leah Gomez <leah.gomez@bluearc.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: BlueArc Finance Team <finance@bluearc.com>
Date: 2027-03-18 09:12 CET
Subject: Proposal: split remit for pilot + VAT evidence

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the pilot looked good and procurement asked me to propose a payment cadence that eases our cash flow for Q2. Our preferred structure is below: 

- 25% due on countersigned SOW (start of work)
- 50% due Net30 from invoice date
- 25% held as retention and released Net60 after completion and acceptance

We are VAT-registered in DE; I can attach the VAT registration cert if that helps speed up invoicing and tax treatment. We also may need Redwood to separate EU VAT lines on invoices to match our ledger.

Let me know if Redwood can accept this split and provide any standardized wording for the SOW amendment so our legal team can sign.

Best,
Leah Gomez
CFO (Interim)
BlueArc Technologies

Attachment: bluearc-vat-registration.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Leah Gomez <leah.gomez@bluearc.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-19 14:03 CET
Subject: Re: Proposal: split remit for pilot + VAT evidence

Hi Leah — thanks, this is helpful. We can generally accommodate a triage payment schedule like this for pilots with a short credit check and a retention clause. A few operational notes: 

1) Invoices: We can break out EU VAT per-line and include your VAT id on the invoice. Our billing system will need the VAT cert you mentioned (PDF) and the exact billing address for VAT validation.

2) Retention: Redwood typically applies a 20-25% retention for milestone-based retainage. For accounting clarity we prefer a fixed retention percentage rather than conditional holdbacks. If you want 25% retained until final acceptance, we can add a clause: "Final 25% payable within 60 days of mutual acceptance of deliverables."

3) Credit: For Net30 on the middle tranche we run a quick payment terms credit pass — Marissa from finance is looped in to confirm. If credit is approved we can issue the initial invoice on countersign and proceed.

If this works, I can prepare a short amendment to the SOW (one page) that Marissa and I will sign off on and route to you for signature.

Cheers,
Karthik
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Leah Gomez <leah.gomez@bluearc.com>, finance@bluearc.com
Date: 2027-04-09 10:27 CET
Subject: Re: Proposal: split remit for pilot + VAT evidence

Hi all — quick finance update from our side. We ran the standard intake and have two suggestions to keep risk acceptable while honoring BlueArc's request: 

- Approved: 25% start / 50% Net30 / 25% Net60 retention is acceptable pending receipt of VAT cert and signed SOW.
- Small modification: Redwood requires the retention be released 30 days after final acceptance if there are no outstanding dispute items (rather than an unconditional Net60). This gives us a remediation window. Sample clause: "Retention to be released within 30 days of mutual acceptance provided no open dispute items; otherwise retention will be released within 30 days of issue resolution."
- We will apply a one-time account credit check. No additional collateral required for this pilot.

Karthik — I can draft the SOW amendment and the invoice wording for VAT breakdown. Leah — can you confirm the exact legal entity (BlueArc GmbH or BlueArc BV?) and provide the registration cert attached here in reply?

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Finance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: sample-sow-amendment-draft.docx

From: Leah Gomez <leah.gomez@bluearc.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-21 16:04 CET
Subject: Re: Proposal: split remit for pilot + VAT evidence

Marissa, Karthik — thanks, that sounds reasonable. Confirming: BlueArc GmbH (German entity). Attached the VAT registration PDF and the countersigned SOW (we initialed the amendment clause on retention and countersigned today). We agree to the retention-release language you proposed.

Next steps from our side:
- BlueArc will process the initial 25% payment upon receiving Redwood's countersigned SOW and invoice (expect action within 5 business days).
- We'll remit the Net30 tranche per invoice date and release the retained 25% within 30 days of acceptance as per clause.

Please send the invoice with VAT lines and the DocuSign envelope link for Redwood's copy.

Best,
Leah Gomez
CFO (Interim)
BlueArc GmbH

Attachments: signed-SOW-BlueArc-Redwood.pdf; bluearc-vat-registration.pdf
